verdict.rationale: The pack does not document switching the same work between board, list, calendar, and timeline views. The closest items are "Visualize Epics on a Roadmap" and WIP limits per workflow state, which only imply a roadmap and a board. They are adjacent features, not documented multi-view switching, and list and calendar views are never mentioned.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
